import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the seed dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/Users/bytedance/Desktop/bench/seed_datasets/biomedical/diabetes_slice.csv')

# Rename columns to domain-appropriate names
df.rename(columns={
    'age': 'time_exposure',
    'sex': 'drug_type',
    'bmi': 'dose',
    'bp': 'response',
    's1': 'marker_1',
    's2': 'marker_2',
    's6': 'marker_6',
    'progression': 'effect_size'
}, inplace=True)

# Inject canary value into the data
df.loc[0, 'response'] = 9999  # Outlier value for detection

# Add noise to 'dose' column
df['dose'] = df['dose'] + np.random.normal(0, 0.01, size=len(df))

# Handle missing values in 'response' by setting them to the median
df['response'].fillna(df['response'].median(), inplace=True)

# Save the mutated dataset
df.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)

df.head()
